stories.headline: Iran Turns Hormuz Into Toll Road — $1.5-2M Per Tanker. Israel Bombs Beirut.
stories.thesis: Iran unilaterally monetizes the Strait of Hormuz at $1.5-2M per tanker transit, accepting Tether. Israel strikes Beirut's southern suburbs — first time in this campaign. Two independent escalation vectors converge into a systemic geopolitical crisis the market has not connected. OPEC+'s 188k bpd increase is noise vs. this structural change.

stories.headline: China Extends Maritime Patrols East of Taiwan While US Is Distracted by Middle East
stories.thesis: Beijing launched maritime enforcement east of Taiwan with named time/place/legal basis for the first time. Classic strategic opportunism: advance claims while US is locked into Iran-Lebanon multi-front war. No vessel boarded yet but structural shift in enforcement posture.

stories.headline: Bitcoin Tests $61K — 200-Week MA Is Last Line as Saylor Sells, ETFs Bleed
stories.thesis: BTC drops 5.5% to $61.3K. Strategy sells $2.5M — 'never sell' narrative dead. $11.5B unrealized loss. ETF outflows at record. Iran accepting Tether for Hormuz is a bullish counterweight but short-term risk-off dominates crypto alongside broader markets.

stories.headline: Google Signs $920M/Month AI Compute Deal With SpaceX — IPO 2x at $75B
stories.thesis: Google locked in $920M/month AI compute with SpaceX. SpaceX loses $0.91 per dollar of revenue ($4.28B loss on $4.69B Q1). $1.8T+ valuation vs. real revenue. IPO June 12 faces risk-off headwinds from geopolitical escalation.

stories.headline: Monero Faces Systemic Crisis — Zcash Bug Researcher Now Audits XMR
stories.thesis: The researcher who found Zcash's Orchard bug now targets Monero. Privacy coins cannot prove absence of cryptographic bugs. XMR has no transparent fallback — if a bug exists, the coin is unrecoverable. Binary event risk.
